summary: Preinstall downloads Bun runtime to execute an obfuscated bundled payload
details: @onereach/ui-components@27.0.3 advertises itself as a Vue components library but ships a preinstall lifecycle hook (`preinstall: node setup.mjs`) that executes automatically on `npm install`. setup.mjs is obfuscator-mangled (rotated string-array decoder, `_0xXXXX` identifiers) and at install time downloads a Bun runtime archive from `github.com/oven-sh/bun/releases`, extracts the `bun` binary to a temp directory, chmods it 0755, and uses it to execute the sibling `math_init.js` — a 727 KB Bun-compiled bundle that is itself obfuscated (rotated string-array function, mangled identifiers, indexed string decoder). Executing an opaque, obfuscated bundle via a freshly-downloaded alternate language runtime has no build-tooling justification for a Vue UI-components package and evades scanners that only inspect Node-resolved code. Whatever `math_init.js` does, it runs unaudited on every `npm install` of this package.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
